lines: Sab qatl ho ke tere muqaabil se aaye hain
couplets.en: We stood before you and came away slain.

lines: Hum log surkh-ru hain ki manzil se aaye hain
couplets.en: We can hold our heads high, having reached our destination.
All of us slain at your hand.

lines: Sham-e-nazar, khayaal ke anjum, jigar ke daagh
couplets.en: The lamp of the gaze, the stars of thought, the wounds of the heart.

lines: Jitne charaagh hain teri mehfil se aaye hain
couplets.en: Every lamp was lit at your gathering.
All of us slain at your hand.

lines: Har ik qadam ajal tha, har ik gaam zindagi
couplets.en: Every step was death, every stride a life.

lines: Hum ghoom phir ke koocha-e-qaatil se aaye hain
couplets.en: We wandered through the killer's lane and came back.
All of us slain at your hand.

lines: Is bazm mein shaheed-e-jafa jaane kaun ho
couplets.en: Who can say whom cruelty will claim in this gathering?

lines: Sar ba-salaam husn ki mehfil se aaye hain
couplets.en: We came away from beauty's gathering with our heads still bowed.
All of us slain at your hand.
